set: ["skin problems from the patch", "patch", "protect skin from sun", "itching from allergic skin conditions", "severe skin reactions from omeprazole", "kidney problems from omeprazole", "under the skin", "injection under the skin", "apply the skin patch to your hip area 2 hours before an effect is needed", "purple spots under the skin", "milk production from the breasts", "patchy darkening of the skin on the face", "do not wear the patch longer than 9 hours a day", "acid backup from the stomach into the esophagus", "reducing glucose absorption from the intestines", "skin pain"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
